sources.title: Kosovo Visas | Embassies of the Republic of Kosovo
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Diaspora of the Republic of Kosovo
sources.officialityEvidence: The live ambasadat.net platform identifies Kosovo's Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Diaspora in its footer. It lists Fiji (Fixhi) among visa-exempt countries, defines the visa-required residual rule, and publishes the in-person consular procedure.
sources.supportingExcerpt: you must apply for a Kosovo visa

sources.title: Decision No. 02/237: Bosnia and Herzegovina identity-card entry
sources.publisher: Government of the Republic of Kosovo
sources.officialityEvidence: The Prime Minister's official kryeministri.rks-gov.net domain hosts the signed Government decision. It directly limits the Bosnia and Herzegovina exemption to travel with a valid biometric identity card and makes the decision effective on Gazette publication.
sources.supportingExcerpt: with a valid biometric identity card

sources.title: Decision No. 14/280 amending the Fiji visa-regime annex
sources.publisher: Government of the Republic of Kosovo
sources.officialityEvidence: The Prime Minister's official domain hosts signed Decision No. 14/280, which amends the Fiji visa-regime annex but expressly makes effect conditional on publication in the Official Gazette.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Vendimi hyn në fuqi ditën e publikimit në Gazetën Zyrtare të Republikës së Kosovës.

sources.title: Official Gazette of the Republic of Kosovo
sources.publisher: Official Gazette of the Republic of Kosovo
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Government Gazette register provides search fields and legal-act records. Searches for Fiji/Fixhi and Decision 14/280 did not retrieve a publication record; that unsuccessful search is recorded only as a currentness limitation, not as proof of nonpublication.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Gazeta Zyrtare e Republikës së Kosovës

conflicts.officialStatus: unresolved: live Fiji waiver listing conflicts with a signed Fiji visa amendment whose Gazette effect is unverified
conflicts.explanation: Kosovo's live MFA schedule directly lists Fiji as visa-exempt, while signed Decision No. 14/280 introduces a Fiji visa regime only on Official Gazette publication. No publication record or later controlling Fiji act was retrieved, so the fallback cannot be confirmed or corrected.

unresolved.reason: Decision No. 02/237 directly establishes Bosnia and Herzegovina visa exemption only with a valid biometric identity card, not an ordinary passport. Its own Gazette-publication condition is also not a passport rule. No current Kosovo or Bosnia primary source directly establishes the ordinary Bosnian-passport short-visitor baseline; do not convert the identity-card route, recognition, or an unlisted-country residual into a passport result.

Kosovo's live MFA schedule directly lists Fiji (Fixhi) as visa-exempt, but signed Decision No. 14/280 introduces a Fiji visa regime only from Official Gazette publication. The current Gazette register search did not retrieve that publication or a later controlling act, which is not treated as proof of nonpublication. This material conflict prevents selection of either the fallback visa-free status or an advance-visa status.
